MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The memory card and reader fit my repeated purchases of removable storage and transfer accessories, provided the card works with my devices.",
    "The Fire TV Stick offers another way to watch on my existing TV alongside my DVD player, although 4K adds no benefit to my 720p screen."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Internal SSDs serve a different purpose from the memory cards I buy; I have no current computer upgrade need or confirmed compatibility.",
    "Earbuds, speakers, and smart lighting do not address the camera, storage, and device-accessory needs reflected in my purchases.",
    "A router replacement would make sense if I had a connection problem, but nothing in my recent shopping indicates one."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire tablet purchase seems to have been taken as interest in Alexa speakers and smart-home devices, even though I bought practical accessories for the tablet.",
    "My storage purchases seem to have been interpreted as interest in any storage product, overlooking the difference between removable cards and internal computer drives."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I repeatedly choose accessories that support equipment I already use, such as tripods, cables, card holders, readers, and a lens cap.",
    "Exact compatibility matters: card format, connector type, lens size, and device support determine whether an accessory is useful to me.",
    "My frequent purchases do not mean I currently need unrelated electronics; a clear use with my existing equipment matters more."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my storage and TV interests but stretched my practical accessory shopping into unsupported computer-upgrade and smart-home needs."
}
